content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry, for episode ep-05001. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease, reported under diagnosis codes I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91. Per the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. Authorization status is recorded as missing, and we request review of this documented medical necessity for the $738.30 balance."}
